hardhat.fixedVersion: No standalone advisory; remove affected task dependencies or separately validate Hardhat 3 migration
hardhat.runtimeRationale: Hardhat is an executed local runtime, not dev-only. Product checks hardhat/31337, no forking, precompiled artifacts, fixed harmless actions and fresh framework accounts. Build/test/CLI/analytics/Sentry/fork modules are removed. Inherited advisories are dispositioned separately; no arbitrary compiler, YAML, ZIP, test serializer or remote-network API is exposed.

undici.runtimeRationale: Retained Hardhat HTTP/provider utility dependency. The in-process product provider imports HTTP error helpers but never constructs a remote HttpProvider; hardhat/31337 and no-fork checks reject external networks. The phone transport uses the existing Node HTTP host, not Undici WebSockets or a user-selected URL. No affected HTTP/WebSocket sink receives attacker input in this Beta scope.
